what.text: This page follows refugees from Ethiopia living in South Sudan, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 6578 Ethiopian refugees in South Sudan, 4.0% of all refugees from Ethiopia.
Sudan hosts the most Ethiopian refugees, followed by Kenya, Uganda and South Africa.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Ethiopia with the TPLF from 2020 to 2022, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflicts over Oromiya territory in periods from 2006 to 2025 and over Ogaden territory from 2006 to 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2011 at 4967 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2011 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Sudan.
These are year-end totals for South Sudan only, reported to UNHCR.
